课程简介（中文）

本课程主要讲授如下章节: DN的复制、DNA 损伤修复、RNA转录与加工、蛋白质的生物合成、基因的表达调控、表观遗传调控、基因工程和基因编辑以及转录组学等分子生物学相关技术简介等。本课程系统讲授分子生物学基本知识，基础理论和研究方法，介绍分子生物学的新成果、新进展、今后发展的趋势及面临的挑战。

课程简介（英文）

This course mainly teaches following chapters: DNA replication, DNA damage repair, RNA transcription and processing, protein biosynthesis, gene expression regulation, epigenetic regulation, genetic engineering and gene editing, and an introduction to molecular biology related technologies such as transcriptomics. This course systematically teaches the basic knowledge, basic theories and research methods of molecular biology, and introduces the new achievements, new progress, future development trends and challenges faced by molecular biology.

教学目标

Through the teaching of this course, we help students to understand and master the process of replication, transcription and translation of genetic information molecules in living organisms; to understand and master the characteristics and rules of the regulation of gene expression; to have a greater improvement in their ability and quality, and to enter into the study of the subsequent postgraduate courses with a better overall quality, higher interest in learning, a more solid knowledge base and a good learning state.

教学方式

The teaching will be provided with distinct gradation and accurate expression, and highlight the key points, integrate theory with practice, and will be vivid and interesting, and inspire thinking. Adaptation of multimedia and other modern educational technology to assist teaching will be employed to enrich classroom teaching and to improve teaching level and quality. Attention should be paid to the reform of each teaching link and the organic connection between each teaching link during the teaching process.
